summary: Create the portal's AAP API token as an AAP admin: Access Management > API Tokens > Create API Token, add a description, select the portal OAuth application, choose scope Write, create and save it for the OpenShift secret the Helm chart reads.
questions: How do I create an API token for self-service automation portal?
Which scope does the portal AAP token need?
Where do I create API tokens in AAP 2.6?
